definitions.explanation: The sensation perceived by the tongue when eating or drinking something. Can refer to sweet, salty, sour, bitter, or umami flavors.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{食|た}べ{物|もの}→食べ物：02890_tabemono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{味|あじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。

examples.english: This tea has a slightly bitter taste, but it's good for your health.

notes:
{味|あじ} refers to the sensation of flavor when eating or drinking.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {味|あじ}がする: to taste (of something)
- {味|あじ}がいい: tastes good
- {味|あじ}を{見|み}る: to taste, to sample
- {味|あじ}を{付|つ}ける: to season, to add flavor

FLAVOR TYPES:
- {甘|あま}い{味|あじ}: sweet taste
- {辛|から}い{味|あじ}: spicy taste
- {苦|にが}い{味|あじ}: bitter taste
- {酸|す}っぱい{味|あじ}: sour taste
- {旨味|うまみ}: umami (savory taste)

COMPOUNDS:
- {味見|あじみ}: tasting, sampling
- {調味料|ちょうみりょう}: seasoning
- {味付|あじつ}け: seasoning, flavoring

Figuratively used to describe character: {人生|じんせい}の{味|あじ} (the flavor of life).
